ac_evidence.ac: Typed findings exist in runtime and can represent review, CI, drift, and QA failures
Early draft PR is created by runtime before the late PR phase
QA/UAT is a real orchestrator phase after CI and before done
Review and QA failures emit blocking findings into the same Beads loop

existing_work_summary: Orchestrator already had build/review/pr/ci phases, but findings and QA/UAT were not first-class runtime state before this slice.
